sources.title: Best VRAM Cheat Sheet for Local LLMs: Every Model, Every Quant
sources.snippet: A 35B-A3B needs ~20GB for its weights, but that can be ~10GB VRAM + ~11GB RAM — ~38 tok/s on a 12GB RTX 3060, measured. The "VRAM at Q4" figures in the table below assume the whole model sits in VRAM; treat them as the fully-on-GPU ceiling, not the floor.
